summary: Two snowmobilers stuck in downed trees on the Corona Trail system near Woods Landing outside Winter Park; uninjured but becoming hypothermic; started a fire while crews worked to reach them; extricated
location: Corona Trail system, Woods Landing outside Winter Park
responding_agency: Grand County Search and Rescue, Grand County Sheriff's Office, Grand County Advanced Backcountry Snowmobile Team, US Forest Service
notes: Date inferred: GCSAR post dated 3/15/21 (Monday) says incident was "on Sunday" -> 2021-03-14 (verified Sunday); 2:30 p.m. response per post; Sky Hi News link present in post
